description: “Classic MI energy—Ethan Hunt never slows. The stunts were next‑level.”

title: F1 (The Movie) (2025)
description: “High‑octane racing thrills—felt like Top Gun on wheels. My pulse was racing.”

title: Bride Hard (2025)

title: Cleaner (2025)
description: “Die Hard vibes in London—simple, effective action. Hit it just right.”

title: K-Pop Demon Hunters (2025)
description: “Ear‑worm K‑pop + demon‑slaying—wild combo, but I was hooked.”

title: The Fall Guy (2024)
description: “Stunt‑man caper—funny, slick, and blast‑packed. Ryan Gosling nailed it.”

title: Diablo (2025)
description: “Scott Adkins wrecking shop—brutal, no frills, hard‑hitting martial arts.”

title: Onslaught (2025)
description: “Monster mayhem meets action horror. Not subtle, but satisfying.”

title: Skyline: Warpath (2025)
description: “Alien martial arts madness—over‑the‑top but strangely fun.”

title: Captain America: Brave New World (2025)
description: “Solid spy‑action with Captain America—smarter than I expected.”

title: Inside Out 2 (2024)
description: “Jordan really connected with Anxiety. Caleb laughed a lot more than expected.”

title: Kung Fu Panda 4 (2024)
description: “Silly and sincere. Still hits. Everyone had a good time with Po.”

title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire (2024)
description: “Both kids loved the mix of spooky and funny. They quoted it for days.”

title: Wish (2023)
description: “Watched this one again—it was whimsical enough even for teens. Jordan liked the songs.”

title: Nimona (2023)
description: “Caleb said it was ‘chaotic cool.’ Jordan said it made them cry a little.”

title: The Spider Within: A Spider-Verse Story (2024)
description: “Short but powerful. They talked about Miles and stress for hours.”

title: Wonka (2023)
description: “A little weird, but charming. The kids liked it more than expected.”

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem (2023)
description: “Retro cool and super fun. Caleb wants to rewatch it.”

title: Elemental (2023)
description: “Jordan said it was better than expected. They both liked Ember.”

title: Leo (2023, Netflix)
description: “Goofy lizard movie—Caleb loved Adam Sandler’s voice acting. Easy family night pick.”

title: Back to the Future (1985)
description: John explained flux capacitors while the kids laughed at Marty’s style.

title: Ghostbusters (1984)
description: They all shouted 'who you gonna call!' Caleb pretended to be Venkman for a week.

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)
description: John said this was his favorite Indy. The kids liked the motorcycle chase best.

title: Jurassic Park (1993)
description: Caleb was obsessed with the raptors. Jordan hid during the T-Rex scene.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire (1993)
description: Robin Williams cracked them up. Jordan said 'he’s chaos in a sweater!'

title: The Iron Giant (1999)
description: Jordan cried. John said 'I’m not crying, you’re crying.'

title: The Sandlot (1993)
description: Perfect summer movie. Caleb yelled 'you’re killing me, Smalls!' for days.

title: Men in Black (1997)
description: Aliens and one-liners. John explained the jokes while the kids just laughed.

title: The Princess Bride (1987)
description: Jordan kept quoting it. John mouthed every line. 'As you wish' hit hard.

title: The Goonies (1985)
description: They all loved the adventure vibe. Caleb asked if they could go on a treasure hunt.

title: Home Alone (1990)
description: Caleb howled at the traps. John said it holds up surprisingly well.

title: The Matrix (1999)
description: John explained the philosophy. Kids were here for the slow-mo kicks.

title: Hook (1991)
description: Jordan said Robin Williams made a great Peter Pan. John agreed.

title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids (1989)
description: Caleb said 'being tiny would be cool!' Jordan wanted a pet ant.

title: Empire Strikes Back (1980)
description: John insisted they start with this one. Jordan loved Yoda.

title: The Lion King (1994)
description: Nostalgic for John. Emotional for everyone. Caleb sang along.

title: Beetlejuice (1988)
description: Jordan found it spooky-funny. John explained Tim Burton style.

title: The Truman Show (1998)
description: Jordan said 'that’s kinda like TikTok but creepy'. John nodded slowly.

title: Toy Story (1995)
description: A classic. John said it changed animation forever. Caleb loved the humor.

title: Mulan (1998)
description: Jordan liked the music. John said 'Eddie Murphy carried the whole dragon thing.'
